title: Acne Scar Treatment in Dubai | SOLAR
descr: Acne scar treatment in Dubai at a licensed clinic in Sobha Hartland: RF microneedling, Dermapen, peels, PRX-T33. Protocol after examination. Free consultation.

hero.8: Acne Scar Treatment in Dubai (Sobha Hartland) - Smoother Texture, Step by Step
hero.7: Post-acne marks are not one problem but several: narrow ice pick scars, sharp-edged boxcar scars, soft rolling depressions, enlarged pores and dark stagnant spots. Each type responds to a different method, so we start with an examination and skin diagnostics, then build a course - usually 3 to 6 sessions with intervals between them.
hero.1: RF microneedling, Dermapen, chemical peels, PRX-T33
hero.0: 45-60 minutes per session, a course of 3-6 with 3-4 week intervals.

what.10: Acne scars form when inflammation damages collagen in the deeper layers of the skin and the repair leaves a dent, a fibrous band or a pigment mark.
what.9: No device removes that damage in one pass: the work is to trigger controlled remodelling of collagen again and again, so the edges of each scar soften and the surface levels out.
what.6: Microneedling and fractional laser create thousands of tiny channels that the skin repairs with new collagen. The intact tissue between the channels is what makes recovery quick.
what.3: Rolling scars are held down by fibrous strands underneath. Needling and radiofrequency energy loosen those strands so the depression can lift.
what.0: Chemical peels and PRX-T33 work on tone, stagnant post-inflammatory spots and the roughness that makes texture read as damaged skin even when the scars themselves are shallow.

benefits.13: Why a planned course beats a single "strong" procedure.
benefits.11: A protocol built for your scar type
benefits.10: After the examination the doctor names which methods suit your skin and in what order, instead of applying one device to everything.
benefits.7: Each session adds collagen. Texture improves gradually over the course, and the difference is usually clearest in photographs taken under the same light.
benefits.3: Most protocols mean redness for one to three days. Sessions are spaced so you always know when your skin will look its calmest.
benefits.0: We improve scars, we do not erase them. The doctor tells you at the consultation what degree of improvement is realistic for your skin before you commit to a course.

whyTitle.0: The word "post-acne" covers several distinct kinds of damage, and what helps one type does little for another.

whyCards.9: Narrow and deep, like a pinprick that goes straight down. They need energy delivered into the depth rather than surface polishing, which is where radiofrequency microneedling is usually the main tool.
whyCards.6: Round or oval depressions with sharp vertical edges. The aim is to soften the edge and build collagen in the floor of the scar, so fractional laser and needling are combined across the course.
whyCards.3: Wide, soft undulations held down by fibrous bands. Loosening the tether matters more than resurfacing, and improvement typically appears later in the course than with other types.
whyCards.0: Brown or red marks that are flat, not indented. These are not scars in the structural sense and often respond to peels, PRX-T33 and consistent home care with sun protection. Most skin carries a mix of types, so the protocol, the number of sessions and the intervals are set after an examination and 3D skin diagnostics, not from a photograph.

evTitle.0: Atrophic acne scarring is one of the better-studied areas in dermatology, and the three methods we use are the ones most often examined in the literature.

evCards.12: Studies of percutaneous collagen induction in atrophic acne scars report improvement in scar severity scores after a series of sessions, with the effect building across the course rather than after a single treatment.
evCards.7: Comparative and split-face research on fractional resurfacing describes measurable improvement in atrophic scars, with the trade-off between ablative and non-ablative settings expressed mainly as more downtime for a stronger single-session effect.
evCards.2: Reviews of chemical peeling for acne scarring and post-inflammatory pigmentation report benefit for surface texture and tone, and note that repeated, correctly spaced sessions matter more than the strength of any one peel.
evCards.0: The studies refer to the methods (microneedling, fractional lasers, chemical peels), not to a specific clinic. Results are individual and depend on scar type, skin type and how consistently the course is completed.

indTitle.0: From atrophic scars to dull, uneven texture.

indItems.12: Fresh marks left by recent breakouts
indItems.0: RF microneedling has its own page: see RF Microneedling Virtue RF.

steps.13: The doctor examines the skin under magnification, identifies which scar types are present and checks whether acne is still active.
steps.9: 3D Skin Test Janus III maps texture, pores and pigment and gives a baseline image to compare against later in the course.
steps.5: Usually 3 to 6 sessions with 3-4 week intervals, combining methods: RF microneedling or Dermapen for structure, peels and PRX-T33 for tone and surface.
steps.1: The doctor compares the diagnostics, decides whether to extend the course, and sets home care - retinoids and sun protection do a large part of the work between sessions.
steps.0: Good to know: strict daily sun protection is part of the treatment, not an optional extra. Without it, new pigment marks form faster than the course can improve them.

priceTitle.0: The price depends on the methods your skin needs and the length of the course, and is confirmed at the free doctor's consultation. Message us on WhatsApp.

results.6: Redness settles and the skin looks fresher and more even. This early glow is not yet the scar result.
results.3: New collagen starts to change the relief: pores look tighter, boxcar edges soften, makeup sits more smoothly.
results.0: Collagen remodelling continues after the last session, so the texture keeps improving for several months. Rolling scars are usually the slowest to respond.

faq: How many sessions will I need?

Most people need 3 to 6, spaced 3 to 4 weeks apart. Deep ice pick and rolling scars often need the upper end of that range, and the doctor reassesses partway through rather than selling a fixed package up front. The number of sessions and the methods are what the price depends on, and the course plan with its price is agreed at the free consultation.

No. Acne scars are structural damage in the dermis, and honest treatment improves their depth, edges and visibility rather than erasing them. Most clients see a clear improvement in texture and in how the skin catches light, which is what makes scars noticeable in the first place.

Redness for one to three days after microneedling or RF, similar to sunburn, with some peeling after stronger peels. You can wear makeup again once the skin has closed, usually the next day, and sessions are scheduled around your plans.
Can it be done while acne is still active?

Not in the inflamed areas. Active breakouts need to be treated first, otherwise a procedure can spread inflammation and create new marks. The doctor may start with peels and cleansing while the acne is being brought under control.
When will I see the result?

Texture starts to look different after the second or third session, and the fullest effect appears 3 to 6 months after the course ends, because collagen keeps remodelling long after the last treatment.
What is the price of acne scar treatment in Dubai?
The price depends on the zones, the protocol and the number of sessions you need. It is agreed at the free consultation with the doctor, before anything is booked, and there are no hidden extras.

How much does acne scar treatment cost in Dubai?

At SOLAR in Dubai the cost of acne scar treatment depends on the methods your skin needs and the length of the course. A full course is planned and priced at the free consultation once the doctor has seen which scar types your skin actually has.

  • PRX-T33, face. A needle-free option for tone, stagnant marks and surface texture; often used between stronger sessions.
  • Dermapen with Genosys mesotherapy, face. Microneedling with a cocktail for texture, pores and overall skin quality.
  • Dermapen with PDRN, face. A regenerative cocktail for skin that repairs slowly or is still recovering from active acne.
  • Dermapen with ASCE exosomes, face. The most intensive Dermapen protocol, chosen for pronounced texture damage.
  • RF microneedling Virtue RF, face. Radiofrequency energy at depth, the main tool for ice pick and boxcar scars.
  • Deep facial cleansing. Often the first step before a course, so the skin starts clean.
  • 3D Skin Test Janus III diagnostics. Baseline images to measure the course against.

What changes the price

  • Scar type: deep atrophic scars need radiofrequency sessions, while pigmentation often responds to peels alone.
  • Number of sessions: most courses are 3 to 6; the doctor gives the range before you start.
  • Cocktail choice: the Dermapen price changes with what is delivered into the channels.
  • Area: the face, the back or a combination of both.

There are no hidden extras: the consultation is free and the course plan with its price is agreed with you before the first session.

Acne scar treatment near you

The clinic is in Sobha Hartland, Mohammed Bin Rashid City - 220 m from the bus stop and with free parking, so it is an easy drive from most of central Dubai:

Sobha Hartland - on site · Business Bay - ~10 min · Downtown Dubai - ~12 min · Dubai Creek Harbour - ~12 min · Meydan - ~8 min · Ras Al Khor - ~10 min · Al Jaddaf - ~10 min
